authorityFingerprint: not-applicable: test classification, not a primitive capability
problemStatement: Six adversarial tests in tests/pressure/test_pressure_direct.py target PPA methods (delegate, dispute_payment, issue_invoice and their getters) that were gas-modularized out of the core contract to fit the Bradbury per-tx ceiling. They currently fail with AttributeError. They are not regressions, but they are an evidence-integrity gap: AGENTS.md mandates a set of adversarial questions, and six of them are unanswerable against the current core deploy. Leaving them failing misreports the repository state; deleting or migrating them would destroy the specification.
scopeRationale: Tests only. No primitive implementation, CAPABILITY.json, capability version, or the PPA v0.3 lane is touched. The superseded v0.2 spine vectors are explicitly NOT to be migrated as part of this work.

affectedTests.mandatoryProperty: delegation narrows limits and never widens; revocation kills future spend immediately
an expired delegation confers no authority
account allowlist still binds a delegate
refund is a compensating entry; settled history is never rewritten; no double refund
dispute requires an existing payment and correct authority; duplicate disputes rejected
an invoice settles exactly once and only through the send gates

Assertion bodies are preserved verbatim — no assertion is deleted, weakened, or rewritten

A skipped pressure test is never reported as passing behavior: the suite summary distinguishes passed, skipped, and failed

Full repository suite re-run with honest accounting; expected result is 150 passed, 8 skipped, 0 failed
The report states plainly that pressure behavior is specified but not executable in the current core deploy
AGENTS.md-mandated adversarial questions that remain unexecutable are enumerated by name in the report
explicitlyForbidden: Do not restore delegate, invoice, or dispute methods to the core contract.
Do not migrate or revive the superseded v0.2 spine vectors.
Do not delete or weaken any assertion.
Do not count a skipped test as passing.
Do not widen the PPA v0.3 origin lane or the modular-split lane.
